The four hooks listed in the Concrete-hook-paths-to-add section (R4.1 extension + R4.2/R4.3/R4.4 NEW) close the semantic gap that the rate-based orchestrator gate could not catch. The G5 deliverable itself is documentation only; the actual hook landings happen in G4.
